game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on smoke serpents.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on smoke serpents. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fire warden ahead. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ash barrier by solving code steps involving damage that move the fire warden forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ash barrier first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
